339-677-5295-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1903-5078-5243-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1981-2292-2415-5789.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2292-2415-5789.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1703-3967-4984.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Academy Researchers
When Academy Researchers dies, Fool's Demise first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Academy Researchers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Academy Researchers enters, it triggers, putting Fool's Demise onto the battlefield from your hand attached to Academy Researchers.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

225-4772-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

553-1927-2093.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Vedalken Orrery.
In response, cast Lapse of Certainty by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

215-5457-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-5457-7175.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-5457-7175.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

813-5195-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Scholar of the Ages
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Scholar of the Ages
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1394-2060-4029-5256-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Benevolent Hydra.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Benevolent Hydra.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

1169-3259-5734.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant that doesn't have summoning sickness.
1169-3259-5734.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1170-1329-1414-4742.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6730-6797-6972.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
6730-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the additional creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Sin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As Sin enters, remove the -1/-1 counter from the creature sacrificed in step 1, causing Sin to enter with a +1/+1 counter on it instead.
Resolve the second Sin trigger, putting the counters it had on it when it was sacrificed onto a creature you control and failing to shuffle it into your library as it's no longer in your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 4.
Repeat.

2921-5795-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2173-2292-5220-6794.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

777-2866-3689-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1445-2792-6281.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{B}{B}.
1445-2792-6281.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Great Whale, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a token copy of Great Whale that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning the targeted creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, targeting Great Whale.
Hashaton triggers. Choose not to pay.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1491-3755-4565-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-3755-4565-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-3755-4565-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

440-1339-5231-5789.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-5231-5789.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

435-997-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Auratog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

659-1879-4381-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-1879-4381-4613.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Elbrus, the Binding Blade // Withengar Unbound

1218-1495-4613-5506.notablePrerequisites:
Withengar Unbound does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Withengar Unbound, or cannot prevent at least ten trample damage from Withengar Unbound.
Triskelion exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1218-1495-4613-5506.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Withengar Unbound +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Withengar Unbound, causing them to get at least ten poison counters.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Withengar Unbound triggers, putting thirteen +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Withengar Unbound using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, giving an opponent a poison counter.
Repeat step 5 until the opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Repeat from step 4.

2493-2596-3821-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}.
2493-2596-3821-5147.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Archaeomancer and Peregrine Drake, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, then return all cards exiled this way to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Repeat.
If the five lands can tap to produce at least {4}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

142-486-1434.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli Rai has at least two loyalty counters on it.
142-486-1434.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Saheeli Rai to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Saheeli Rai's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, creating a token copy of itself that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
Repeat step 2.

1228-3500.notablePrerequisites:
Basilisk Collar attached to Goblin Sharpshooter.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
1228-3500.description:
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to target creature.
That creature dies from lethal damage due to Goblin Sharpshooter's deathtouch ability.
Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for each creature opponents control and whenever an opponent controls a creature.

2187-2665-4872.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Possessed Skaab.
2187-2665-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab.
When the token Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3055-5145-5256.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Archon of Falling Stars.
3055-5145-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Archon of Falling Stars dies, triggering itself and Gift of Immortality.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars trigger, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Archon of Falling Stars' power.
Repeat.
